mechanism: Detect H&S / inverted H&S on six ZigZag extremums with min/max correction ratios; interpolate neckline between EndCorrection and StartRShoulder; require Close break then pullback to neck with SL at rebound extremum and TP at head–neck and prior-trend distances (×0.9). Optional ReverseTrade swaps SL/TP1 when pattern fails as continuation (channel).
data_needed: Extremum sequence (Trends/ZigZag); confirmation TF rates; min/max correction; SL backstep; neckline coefficients.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD, EURJPY, GBPJPY, EURGBP, GBPUSD, USDJPY; ~10 months 2018; confirmation TF + pattern TF from EA inputs
why_new_for_mis: Formalizes classical three-top/bottom reversal geometry into a typed change event (neck break + retest) with symbol-conditional reverse flag—usable as a discrete regime-flip sensor.
quote: Most often, the pattern is formed in case of a false breakthrough of the price support/resistance level.

mechanism: 4 inputs = upper-shadow%, lower-shadow%, body%, trend(0/1) of last closed candle; feed-forward 4-4-5-3 net with HyperTan hidden layers and Softmax BUY/SELL/HOLD; fire if class prob >0.6. Weights/biases trained via Strategy Tester optimization (−1..1 step 0.001), Open Prices Only.
data_needed: OHLC of last closed bar; 63 weight/bias parameters; Softmax outputs.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: H4 FX backtest ~1 year; MT5 optimizer; MT4/MT5 demo EAs
why_new_for_mis: End-to-end candle-shape → ternary action Softmax sensor in pure MQL—MIS can reuse the feature recipe and graded class probabilities as a sequence/pattern sensor.
quote: we are going to use the relative values of a Japanese candle as input. These values would be the size of the upper shadow, body, lower shadow and direction of the candle

mechanism: ExactZZ_Plus builds highs on Bid high and lows on Ask(low+spread); CZigZagModule copies N extremums and computes SumSegmentsUp/Down, PercentSumSegmentsUp/Down, and PercentSumSegmentsDifference. Small difference ⇒ balanced two-way oscillation (flat); large difference ⇒ unidirectional dominance (trend). Also SegmentsTotalBars/Seconds, PriceRange, Smallest/LargestSegment.
data_needed: ZZ high/low/time buffers; CopyExtremums; MinImpulseSize; optional multi-handle TFs.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD D1; EURMXN M5 (night spread); multi-TF demo current+M15+H1
why_new_for_mis: Turns ZigZag into an explicit flat-vs-trend regime score via opposing-segment sum imbalance, with spread-honest lows for channel trading.
quote: If the difference is insignificant, then the price fluctuates evenly in both directions (flat).

mechanism: SegmentTimes(handle,…) maps an HTF ZZ segment’s true LTF start/stop using min/max extremums inside the first/last HTF bars; then GetZigZagData on that window and PercentSumSegmentsDifference per inner segment. Demo compares H1 segment[0..2] microstructure on M5.
data_needed: HTF+LTF ZZ handles; segment index; LTF bars inside HTF open–open+PeriodSeconds.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: H1 segments analyzed on M5; three inner segments colored separately
why_new_for_mis: Cross-TF sensor: how an HTF swing was built on LTF (choppy vs impulsive)—MIS regime labels can condition on inner-segment imbalance.
quote: we want to know how the specified segment formed on a lower timeframe.

mechanism: FrequencyChangeZZ writes SegmentsTotalBars() of the current extremum set into a subwindow buffer each bar—bar-count span of the last N ZZ segments. Rising values mark slowing directional choice (price indecision); drops mark faster flips.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Chart TF with overlaid ExactZZ; same params as other ZZ sensors
why_new_for_mis: Converts ZigZag tempo into a continuous indecision/acceleration change sensor rather than only price-amplitude signals.
quote: The indicator clearly displays when the price slows down in choosing its direction.

mechanism: SumSegmentsZZ buffers SumSegmentsUp, SumSegmentsDown, and their average; prolonged one-side dominance raises reversal odds. PercentageSegmentsZZ buffers %up, %down, and |%up−%down|; difference below a threshold (with frequent side interchange) flags flat—else use sequential pattern models.
data_needed: CZigZagModule segment sums/percents; Level threshold for scanners.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Chart TF demos; ZZ_Scanner_01 on Forex symbols M5/H1/H8, Level=30, 2018 date range
why_new_for_mis: Dual buffers for directional mass and flatness threshold give MIS a simple ZigZag-derived trend/flat regime pair.
quote: When the difference in percentage ratios between the amounts of multidirectional segments is less than a certain threshold, that can be considered as flat.

mechanism: MultiPercentageSegmentsZZ plots four PercentSumSegmentsDifference series: one HTF plus three LTF windows aligned to the last three HTF segments (SegmentTimes bridging). Colors match part-I EA. Combines HTF bias with nested LTF structure.
data_needed: HigherTimeframe input; CopyExtremum; ExactZZ_Plus on HTF+current; MultiPercentageSegmentsZZ handle.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Default HigherTimeframe=H1 on current chart; tester visualization
why_new_for_mis: Single indicator packs multi-scale ZigZag regime state (HTF + last-3-segment LTF) for MIS multi-horizon sensing.
quote: defines the nature of the formation of several segments from a higher timeframe based on the values of the previous PercentageSegmentsZZ indicator.

mechanism: ZZ_Scanner_02/03: for a symbol/TF date range, histogram counts of segments by size buckets (step in points up to LargestSegment) and, within a size bucket, counts by SegmentBars duration. EURUSD M5 since 2010: 302145 segments, mode in 0–100 pts, max ~2400 pts. Scanner_01 % of bars with PercentageSegments difference > Level across M5/H1/H8 ranks symbols for channel suitability.
data_needed: ExactZZ_Plus history; step; calendars; PercentageSegmentsZZ Level.
